name: Auto Deco
description: Decorate a few blocks by hand and Auto Deco learns your style and decorates the whole level with it.

max-objects.name: Max objects per generation
max-objects.description: Safety cap so a huge level doesn't freeze the editor.

gen-group.name: Generated group ID
gen-group.description: Every generated object is put in this group so 'Clear' can find and remove it. Pick a group your level doesn't use.
